label.label: Button label
label.info: Leave empty for the translated default ("Try it on").

mode.label: Experience
mode.info: On the product page: shoppers get their size right here in an overlay, no app needed. Curtain app: phones open the Curtain app, desktops show a QR code.
mode.embed: On the product page (no app needed)

size_option.label: Size option name
size_option.info: The product option that holds the size. Curtain selects the recommended size in it. Also matches Maat, Taille and Größe.

show_hint.label: Show the privacy hint under the button

unstyled.label: Use my theme's button styling
unstyled.info: Skips Curtain's coral button style so the theme's own styles apply.

shop_key.label: Public shop key override
shop_key.info: pk_live_… or pk_test_…. Filled automatically on install; only set this for a development store.

api_url.label: API origin override
api_url.info: https://api.curtain.fit by default. Only for staging environments.
